passages.text: The following discussion of our financial condition and results of operations is based upon and should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and their related notes included elsewhere in this annual report. This annual report contains forward-looking statements. See “Forward-Looking Information.” In evaluating our business, you should carefully consider the information provided under the caption “Item 3. Key Information—D. Risk Factors” in this annual report. We caution you that our businesses and financial performance are subject to substantial risks and uncertainties. A. Operating Results Overview We are a pioneer and a leading company in the global smart electric vehicle market. We aspire to shape a sustainable and brighter future with the mission of “Blue Sky Coming”. We envision ourselves as a user enterprise where innovative technology meets experience excellence. We design, develop, manufacture and sell smart electric vehicles, driving innovations in next-generation core technologies. We distinguish ourselves through continuous technological breakthroughs and innovations, exceptional products and services, and a community for shared growth. We provide premium smart electric vehicles under the NIO brand, family-oriented smart electric vehicles through the ONVO brand, and small smart high-end electric cars with the FIREFLY brand. In 2025, we delivered 326,028 vehicles, including 178,806 vehicles from our premium smart electric vehicle brand NIO, 107,808 vehicles from our family-oriented smart electric vehicle brand ONVO, and 39,414 vehicles from our small smart high-end electric car brand FIREFLY. credit_strengths.text: Revenue scaled sharply across the three-year window, with vehicle sales carrying the bulk of the top line and parts, power solutions and after-sales services adding a growing non-vehicle annuity. This volume-led expansion is the core support for the credit, though it remains a single-industry, single-cycle revenue base.

Operating cash flow turned positive in the latest year after two years of outflows, and the cash conversion ratio improved markedly year on year. This inflection is the single most important credit-positive development, although the absolute cushion remains thin relative to the capital programme.

key_risks.text: The issuer remains loss-making at the operating line, with a negative operating margin that sits well below the sector median and an EBITDA proxy that is also negative. Leverage ratios are therefore not meaningful; the credit must be judged on liquidity runway rather than earnings-based coverage.

The risk-factor passage flags substantial risks and uncertainties across the business, and the disclosed profile is consistent: a distress-zone Altman score, a current ratio below one and below the sector median, and a working-capital position that leaves little room for demand or pricing shocks.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is deeply negative and far below the sector median, though it improved year on year as operating losses narrowed. Cash interest is modest in absolute terms, but the negative EBITDA proxy means debt service depends on continued operating cash generation rather than on earnings.

Free cash flow is negative because capital expenditure exceeds operating cash flow, and the free-cash-flow-to-debt ratio is below the sector median despite improving year on year. Debt has been reduced over the period, which partly offsets the funding gap, but the capital programme still consumes cash.

overall_credit_view.text: On a net basis the issuer holds a cash surplus once short-term investments are counted, and reported cash alone nearly covers debt. This net-cash position, together with the improving operating cash flow trend, is the main mitigant against the negative earnings profile; the indicative risk profile is not a rating.

Our forward view is that the credit hinges on sustaining the operating cash inflection while funding a heavy capital programme and managing a current ratio below one. Continued loss reduction and disciplined investment would stabilise the profile; a reversal in cash generation would quickly erode the net-cash cushion.

credit_strengths.text: 收入於三年期間大幅增長，汽車銷售佔頂線的大部分，零部件、動力方案及售後服務則帶來持續增長的非汽車年金式收入。此以銷量帶動的擴張是信貸的核心支撐，惟其仍屬單一行業、單一週期的收入基礎。
經營現金流在連續兩年流出後於最近一年轉為正數，現金轉換率按年顯著改善。此轉折點是最重要的信貸正面發展，惟相對於資本開支計劃，絕對緩衝仍然薄弱。

key_risks.text: 發行人於經營層面仍然虧損，經營利潤率為負且遠低於行業中位數，EBITDA 代理指標亦為負數。因此槓桿比率並不具意義；信貸須以流動性跑道而非以盈利為基礎的覆蓋率來評判。
風險因素章節標示業務存在重大風險及不確定性，而披露的狀況與此一致：Altman 分數處於困境區間、流動比率低於一且低於行業中位數，以及營運資金狀況幾無空間承受需求或定價衝擊。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率為深度負值且遠低於行業中位數，惟隨經營虧損收窄而按年改善。現金利息絕對值不大，但 EBITDA 代理指標為負意味著償債依賴持續的經營現金產生而非盈利。
自由現金流為負，因資本開支超過經營現金流，而自由現金流對債務比率雖按年改善仍低於行業中位數。期內債務已有所減少，部分抵銷資金缺口，惟資本開支計劃仍消耗現金。

overall_credit_view.text: 按淨額基準，計入短期投資後發行人持有現金盈餘，而僅呈報現金已幾乎覆蓋債務。此淨現金狀況連同改善中的經營現金流趨勢，是抵禦負面盈利狀況的主要緩解因素；指示性風險狀況並非評級。
我們的前瞻觀點是，信貸取決於能否維持經營現金流的轉折，同時為龐大資本開支計劃提供資金並管理低於一的流動比率。持續減少虧損及紀律性投資將穩定狀況；現金產生一旦逆轉，將迅速侵蝕淨現金緩衝。
